title: City Council District 7
statement: Rockridge's numbers tell a story Temescal and KONO deserve to share—but thriving businesses don't happen by accident. When stable storefronts become the exception rather than the expectation, that's when audits prove their worth.
action: Pulling the last six quarters' small-business retention reports from Economic Development to map service gaps
numberMoved: KONO's street trade holding steady while Rockridge booms—that's the gap policy should bridge
